name: Crownfall: Kingdoms
summary: Crownfall: Kingdoms is a persistent fantasy kingdom strategy game. Players build a stronghold, raise soldiers and spies, plunder other players' kingdoms, and review battle reports. Spies can scout, steal, and assassinate. Players may join alliances, use alliance chat, launch rallies, and take part in timed, multi-phase Epic Battles. The game is free to play, with optional gem in-app purchases.
